title: Scout fidelity: canonical control and crown-band refinement

canonicalSource.featuresMethod: getCandyFeatures("scout"); helmet, face, eyes and chest XY are exact shared paths
canonicalSource.heightNormalization: 30 mm using canonical sampled outline min/max Y

parameters.crownBand: engraved polygon; top z=6.03 mm, floor z=5.73 mm; same canonical XY contour and features

parametersCanonicalJson: {"blendStepsPerQuarterCircle":12,"contourStepsPerQuadratic":12,"crownBand":"engraved polygon; top z=6.03 mm, floor z=5.73 mm; same canonical XY contour and features","depthMm":6.0,"heightMm":30.0,"outerDraftDegrees":2.0,"reliefWallDraftDegrees":8.0}

proportionReadout.exclusion: Mitten tabs occur above the torso measurement range; boots are below it. Width is maximum horizontal span of the exact canonical body path within each stated range.

crownBand.planform: Broad tapered stripe reaching to 29.82 mm, near the canonical crown at 30 mm; it widens toward the helmet rim and has no closed pill/badge outline.
crownBand.strategy: Shallow recessed cut in the existing 6 mm front envelope; no added bulk.

comparisonViews.method: Front, side and three-quarter orthographic views rendered from each exact final STL; common camera scale, lighting, material and flat back.

observations: The refined mesh keeps the exact canonical Scout outline and shared canonical helmet, face, eyes and chest paths.
The crown-band recess is the only geometry change from the canonical v3 solid.
The canonical outline width is measured from source and is not forced to 24 mm.
Mitten cues and the narrow core torso come from the original canonical contour.
limits: Positive geometry study only; no mold-release, coating readability, food-contact, supplier, tolerance, shrink, tooling or manufacturing approval.
The recessed stripe has faceted straight side walls; it is a shape cue, not a proven production relief.
Source contour and feature sampling remain faceted at the shared 12-step quadratic sampling.
